35931.title: We Just Created More Than 1,000 Synthetic Controls To Study California's $20 Fast Food Minimum Wage
35931.zh_title: 我们刚刚创建了超过1,000个合成控制组来研究加州20美元快餐最低工资
35931.authors: Jeffrey Clemens, Olivia Edwards, Jonathan Meer, Joshua D. Nguyen
35931.zh_abstract_excerpt: 合成控制方法有望通过紧密再现处理前结果路径来识别可信的反事实。然而，其可靠性部分取决于它们如何有效地约束研究人员不太可见的自由度。我们通过构建1440个看似合理的可辩护设定来估计加州20美元快餐最低工资的就业效应，从而探索这些方法的敏感性。虽然超过96%的估计就业效应为负，但范围巨大，说明合成控制方法对设定选择敏感。来自更简单且透明得多的双重差分方法的估计值位于合成控制估计值可比分布的中心附近。
35931.abstract: Synthetic control methods hold the promise of identifying a credible counterfactual by closely reproducing pretreatment outcome paths. Their reliability, however, depends in part on how effectively they constrain researchers’ less-visible degrees of freedom. We explore these methods’ sensitivity by constructing 1440 plausibly defensible specifications to estimate the employment effect of California’s $20 fast-food minimum wage. While over 96 percent of the estimated employment effects are negative, the range is vast, illustrating that synthetic control methods are sensitive to specification choice. Estimates from simpler and far more transparent difference-in-differences methods lie near the centers of the comparable distributions of synthetic control estimates. The labor market effects of California's AB 1228 are also analyzed, with varied conclusions, in both the initial and revised version of NBER working paper 34033 and in working paper 35171 .

35930.title: College Success: Understanding the Roles of Financial Aid, Loans, Preparation, and Incentives

35930.authors: Douglas N. Harris, Christopher R. Taber, Yu (Alan) Yang
35930.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在过去四十年中，大学毕业生与非毕业生之间的收入差距大幅扩大，这引发了人们对旨在促进低收入学生接受高等教育的政策的兴趣。这些政策面临的一个关键挑战是高大学辍学率。本文建立了一个包含丰富个体异质性的大学入学和完成学业的动态模型，以评估各种因素如何影响大学入学、辍学和毕业。我们使用纵向调查数据、关于助学金准实验研究的结果以及大规模随机对照试验来估计该模型。我们使用该模型模拟学费补贴、大学贷款、经济激励和增加大学前技能对入学和完成学业的影响。
35930.abstract: Over the past four decades, the earnings gap between college graduates and non-graduates has widened substantially, prompting interest in policies aimed at promoting higher education among low-income students. A key challenge for these policies is the high college dropout rate. This paper develops a dynamic model of college enrollment and completion with rich individual heterogeneity to assess how various factors influence college attendance, dropout, and graduation. We estimate the model using data from longitudinal surveys, results of quasi-experimental studies on grant aid, and large-scale randomized controlled trials. We use the model to simulate the effects of tuition subsidies, college loans, financial incentives, and increased pre-college skills on attendance and completion. We find moderate effects of most unconditional financial policies on attendance, with small effects on completion conditional on attendance. By contrast, some merit-based incentives, such as forgiving student loans upon receipt of a bachelor’s degree, have substantial effects. However, this type of policy and other financial subsidies accrue even more than the others to students from relatively wealthy backgrounds. Overall, it appears infeasible to design a financial aid policy that is simultaneously effective in raising attainment and fiscally progressive. By comparison, we find that the greatest potential for increasing attainment could come from better preparing students for college.

35929.title: The Occupational Ladder: Implications for Life-Cycle Wage Dynamics

35929.authors: Henry E. Siu, Kelly Foley, Guido Matias Cortes
35929.zh_abstract_excerpt: 即使以工人特征为条件，一些职业的工资也高于其他职业，这意味着职业可以按阶梯排序。我们开发了一个简单的分解方法，以研究这种职业阶梯在平均工资增长和生命周期工资分化中的作用。我们提出三个主要发现。第一，随着工人获得经验，就业分布向更高薪职业转移。这对平均生命周期工资增长贡献不大，但在职业生涯早期影响最大。第二，职业就业分布的向上移动并未伴随离散度的增加；因此，职业阶梯并不直接导致工资分化。
35929.abstract: Some occupations pay higher wages than others, even conditional on worker characteristics, implying that occupations can be ranked on a ladder. We develop a simple decomposition to study the role this occupational ladder plays in average wage growth and in the fanning out of wages over the life cycle. We present three main findings. First, the distribution of employment shifts towards higher-paying occupations as workers gain experience. This contributes modestly to average life-cycle wage growth, with greatest impact in early career. Second, this upward movement in the occupational employment distribution is not accompanied by increasing dispersion; thus, the occupational ladder does not directly contribute to the fanning out of wages. Third, early-career workers who are well-positioned on the occupational ladder tend to earn wages far below the occupational average. However, by mid-career, workers’ relative wages within occupations (their positions on the job ladder) no longer depend on their occupation. This change in the covariance between individuals’ positions on the job and occupational ladders is a major contributor to the fanning out of wages over workers’ careers.

35928.title: Strategic Monetary Policy in Open Economies
35928.zh_title: 开放经济中的战略货币政策
35928.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们在一个具有完全金融市场和商品按市场定价的两国新凯恩斯主义框架中考察最优非合作货币政策。与商品一价定律成立的情形相比，即使对自利型政策制定者而言，货币错配也是一个重要考虑因素。金融市场在分析中至关重要。在“完全”承诺下，最优政策考虑对资产价值的影响，从而考虑跨国财富分配的影响。完全承诺下的最优政策不同于“部分”承诺情形，后者直到资产市场出清后才做出政策承诺。令人惊讶的是，完全承诺下战略政策的最优目标规则与合作政策下相同。
35928.abstract: We examine optimal non-cooperative monetary policy in a two-country New Keynesian setting with complete financial markets and pricing to market for goods. In contrast to the case in which the law of one price holds for goods, currency misalignments are an important consideration even for self-oriented policymakers. Financial markets are critical in the analysis. Under “full” commitment, the optimal policy considers the effects on asset values and hence wealth distribution across countries. Optimal policy under full commitment differs from the “partial” commitment case in which the policy commitment is not made until after asset markets clear. Surprisingly, the optimal targeting rule under strategic policy with full commitment is the same as under cooperative policy. In this setting, changes in state-contingent claim prices offset the wealth a self-oriented policymaker might seek through terms-of-trade manipulation, and we show that there are no gains from cooperation. Although a policy chosen under partial commitment may be desirable from a country’s perspective, the resulting Nash equilibrium yields lower welfare.

35927.title: HouseholdBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as Predictors of Household Economic Behavior
35927.zh_title: HouseholdBench：评估大型语言模型作为家庭经济行为预测器
35927.authors: Jin Huang, Diego Ferreras Garrucho, Yutong Xie, Walter M. Yuan, Qiaozhu Mei, Chen Lian, Jonathon Hazell
35927.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大型语言模型（LLM）有潜力实现经济学的一个关键目标：一个适用于各种情境的家庭决策定量模型。然而，现有评估仅涵盖少数调查和结果，且未研究家庭如何适应变化的经济状况。我们引入一项新的评估——HouseholdBench，它整合了6项美国家庭调查和32项预测任务，涵盖数值、分类和概率结果，涉及消费、收入、劳动、预期和住房。利用过去行为、人口统计特征和宏观经济状况，这些任务检验LLM是否能预测行为，包括家庭如何适应各种政策变化。
35927.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have the potential to meet a key goal in economics: a quantitative model of household decision making, across a variety of settings. Yet existing evaluations cover few surveys and outcomes, and do not study how households adjust to changing economic conditions. We introduce a new evaluation, HouseholdBench, which unites 6 U.S. household surveys and 32 prediction tasks spanning numeric, categorical and probabilistic outcomes, related to consumption, income, labor, expectations, and housing. Using past behavior, demographics and macroeconomic conditions, the tasks test whether LLMs predict behavior, including how households adjust to changes in various policies. We evaluate 13 proprietary and open-weight LLMs against a no-change baseline and a gradient boosted tree model. Most LLMs outperform the no-change baseline, including for policy response tasks—with the best model lowering error for numeric outcomes by 12.2%. Across most tasks, gradient-boosted trees rank first; leading proprietary LLMs approach their performance, but open-weight models lag. LLMs exhibit systematic over- and underprediction across different tasks. We identify methods that enable a 4 billion parameter open-weight model to match proprietary models’ performance: fine-tuning and aggregating 16 predictions per observation. Improvements generalize to policy-response tasks, which are excluded from fine-tuning. We release our datasets, code, and leaderboard on our website.

35981.zh_abstract_excerpt: 专业预测者关于2023年通胀如何影响股市的异质性叙事，解释了他们在2022年12月对12个月后通胀和股票回报的定量预期为何存在高度分歧。专业预测者会根据其所持叙事，对通胀前景信息做出异质性方向上的因果性回报预期更新。此外，这些叙事还影响他们在假设性投资组合选择实验中的资产配置。如果代理人认同不同叙事，提供共同信号并不必然导致信念趋同。

35980.title: Demand-Driven Inflation
35980.zh_abstract_excerpt: 后疫情时期的通胀主要由意外强劲的需求力量驱动——无论在美国还是在欧元区都是如此。我们通过一系列逐步丰富设定的结构VAR确立这一结果，并通过标准AD-AS分析和估计的DSGE模型加以解释，同时利用调查预测和实时数据为这一结论提供独立支持。这些需求力量反映了以下因素的组合：疫情限制后意外强劲的积压需求、强于预期的扩张性财政政策，以及异常宽松的货币政策立场。它们共同缓解了不利供给冲击的衰退效应并支撑了复苏，尽管代价是更高的通胀。
35980.abstract: Post-covid inflation was predominantly driven by unexpectedly strong demand forces---both in the United States and in the Euro Area. We establish this result using a sequence of structural VARs with progressively richer specifications, interpret it through the lens of standard AD-AS analysis and an estimated DSGE model, and provide independent support for this conclusion using survey forecasts and real-time data. These demand forces reflected a combination of surprisingly robust pent-up demand following the pandemic restrictions, stronger-than-expected expansionary fiscal policies, and an unusually accommodative monetary stance. Together, they mitigated the recessionary effects of adverse supply shocks and supported the recovery, albeit at the cost of higher inflation. The economic intuition is simple: When a central bank responds forcefully to inflationary pressures, as the Fed and the ECB have done in recent decades, the aggregate demand curve is relatively flat, so supply disturbances move real activity much more than inflation. A large inflation surge, therefore, requires a shift or rotation of the aggregate demand curve.

35979.title: What Drives Censorship on College Campuses?

35979.authors: Peter Arcidiacono, Cory Dowd, Matthew Lilley
35979.zh_abstract_excerpt: 人们普遍担心大学校园中的自我审查，尤其是保守派声音受到压制。使用一所私立精英学院的调查数据，我们表明自我审查并不只是关于保守派身份：自我审查最多的是观点最温和的学生。这一模式与信心和显著性相关——对自己观点更有信心或认为某个问题特别重要的学生往往持有更极端的观点，且自我审查更少。与此同时，保守派的自我审查率高于自由派，同一个人在其相对更保守的观点上比在其相对更自由的观点上更可能自我审查；

35978.title: Coordinated R&D Programs and the Creation of New Industries

35978.authors: Daniel P. Gross, Maria P. Roche
35978.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大型、使命导向的研发努力有时会产生重大技术进展，但其商业影响各不相同。本文利用一项此类努力——美国二战雷达计划——来探讨此类项目的产出如何促进后来的商业发展。我们利用档案记录以及企业进入、专利和技术劳动力流动数据，重建战时雷达研发的组织和产出，记录一个民用产业的战后快速增长，并评估哪些产出被用于后续商业活动。
35978.abstract: Large, mission-oriented R&D efforts sometimes generate substantial technological advances, but their commercial impacts vary. 35977.title: Fixed/Floating Interest Rate Parity
35977.authors: Matthias Fleckenstein, Sven Klingler, Francis A. Longstaff
35977.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出一个新的无套利关系，称之为固定/浮动利率平价。该关系可视为抛补利率平价的国内版本。我们使用规模达数万亿美元的美国机构债券市场中的固定利率债券和浮动利率票据检验这一关系，并记录了显著的偏离。这些偏离在很大程度上与其他套利利差和中介约束指标无关。相反，它们与持有绝大多数机构浮动利率票据的货币市场基金的行为密切相关。我们的结果将客户群效应识别为持续错误定价的一个来源。

Instead, they are closely tied to the behavior of money market funds which hold the vast majority of agency floating-rate notes. Our results identify clientele effects as a source of persistent mispricing.

35976.title: Manufacturing Renaissance Meets Time-Inconsistent Tariffs
35976.zh_title: 制造业复兴遇上时间不一致的关税
35976.authors: Christoph Boehm, Andrei A. Levchenko, Wei Xiang
35976.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们在Venables（1987）框架的动态版本中分析最优关税，其中企业创建存在建设时滞。在这一环境中，贸易保护由以外国贸易伙伴为代价增加本国企业创建的愿望驱动。当企业创建需要时间时，保护的好处在未来实现，而更高消费价格形式的成本则立即发生。在某些参数化下，能够承诺完整关税时间路径的政策制定者在第0期不限制贸易，并宣布在预先指定的未来时期实施高关税。但存在时间不一致性：由于对价格的不利影响，政策制定者的短期激励是不征收当期关税。
35976.abstract: We analyze optimal tariffs in a dynamic version of the Venables (1987) framework with a time-to-build lag in firm creation. In this environment, trade protection is driven by the desire to increase firm creation at home at the expense of the foreign trade partner. When firm creation takes time, the benefits of protection accrue in the future, whereas the costs in the form of higher consumer prices occur immediately. Under certain parameterizations, a policymaker that can commit to a full time path of tariffs leaves trade unrestricted at date 0, and announces high tariffs coming on at a pre-specified future period. But there is a time inconsistency: the policymaker's short-run incentive is not to impose contemporaneous tariffs due to the adverse effect on prices. Thus, lack of commitment to future tariffs can preserve free(er) trade and derail a manufacturing renaissance.

35975.title: The Global Office: How Globalisation’s Frontier is Shifting from Factories to Offices

35975.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文认为，全球化的前沿已从制造业全球价值链转向服务业全球价值链：从全球工厂转向全球办公室。虽然工厂在总贸易中仍然更大，但办公室增长得快得多。中间品贸易热力图显示，工厂呈块状形态并由中国主导，而办公室呈星状形态并由美国主导。引力估计显示，距离对办公室出口的重要性较低，但时区更重要：每增加1小时时区差异使办公室出口减少约4%，而对工厂出口没有影响。
35975.abstract: This paper argues that globalisation’s frontier has shifted from manufacturing GVCs to services GVCs: from the Global Factory to the Global Office. While the Factory remains larger in gross trade, the Office is growing much faster. A heatmap of trade in intermediates shows that the Factory is bloc-shaped and dominated by China, whereas the Office is star-shaped and dominated by America. Gravity estimates show that distance matters less for Office exports, but time zones matter more: each hour of time-zone separation reduces Office exports by roughly 4%, while having no effect on Factory exports. Importantly, all of the world’s export-linked net job creation between 2008 and 2022 occurred in digitally delivered services rather than manufacturing, and trade-linked service jobs command higher average pay globally. The Factory-to-Office shift is also reshaping development. Most emerging economies have seen export-led growth tilt towards services, but their service exports are not yet large enough to drive overall GDP growth the way manufacturing did historically. The big picture is that globalisation’s second unbundling is running out of steam even as its third unbundling is powering ahead. The paper, which raises more questions than it answers, closes with the conjecture that the future of trade is services.

35974.title: How Different are Different Differences-in-Differences? A Large-Scale Meta-Analysis

35974.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我使用AI辅助复制来评估双向固定效应（TWFE）估计中负权重的经验重要性，基于来自108篇经济学论文的1,346个交错采纳设定。TWFE估计与现代双重差分方法的估计高度相关，在10.8–14.5%的比较中观察到符号反转，且TWFE精度更高。考虑估计噪声的层次模型意味着估计量之间的相关性为91–98%，而获得与现代表述符号相反的统计显著TWFE估计的概率为0.6–2.1%。

35973.title: Risk and Return in Government Bonds
35973.zh_title: 政府债券的风险与回报
35973.authors: Matteo Leombroni, Carolin Pflueger, Adi Sunderam
35973.zh_abstract_excerpt: 投资者持有政府债券所要求的补偿是否随其风险而变化？我们使用市场收益率和对未来收益率的专业预测来度量预期超额收益，表明它们与一个标准风险度量紧密相关：债券相对于股票市场的贝塔。在1988年至2024年美国国债的月度-期限面板中，预期超额收益与债券-股票贝塔之间的相关性为67%。这一相关性由市场收益率的变化而非预测者的预期驱动。

We measure expected excess returns using market yields and professional forecasts of future yields, showing that they are tightly linked to a standard measure of risk: bonds’ betas with respect to the stock market. In a month-by-maturity panel of U. S. Treasuries from 1988 to 2024, the correlation between expected excess returns and bond–stock betas is 67%. The correlation is driven by variation in market yields rather than forecasters’ expectations. The relationship between realized excess returns and betas is weak in a univariate regression, but it becomes economically large and significant when we control for monetary-policy and macroeconomic forecast errors. Similar results obtain in an international panel of developed countries from 1989 to 2024. Our findings suggest that variation in risk premia driven by changing bond risk accounts for more than half of both the decline in U.S. long-term bond yields since the mid-1980s and their increase since 2020.

35972.title: Governance Regimes, Economic Mobility, and the Composition of Public Investment: Evidence from the Democratization of Villages in India

35972.authors: Andrew D. Foster, Mark R. Rosenzweig
35972.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们以印度的民主化为动机，开发一个可量化的村庄治理一般均衡模型，以研究政治制度如何塑造公共品提供与经济发展。该模型包含两个群体——地主和无地工人——它们对灌溉、学校和就业项目等公共品有不同偏好。两个群体的家庭都可以进入非农创业，但面临依赖信贷的进入成本。我们比较寡头制（地主控制公共品决策）与民主制（选举竞争根据两个群体的相对规模决定政策）。校准后的模型预测，民主化对公共品和增长的影响并非一致；
35972.abstract: We develop a quantifiable general-equilibrium model of village governance, motivated by India’s democratization, to study how political institutions shape public goods provision and economic development. The model features two groups, landowners and landless workers, with different preferences over public goods such as irrigation, schools, and employment programs. Households from both groups can enter nonfarm entrepreneurship, but face credit-dependent entry costs. We compare oligarchy, where landowners control public goods decisions, with democracy, where electoral competition determines policy based on the relative sizes of the two groups. The calibrated model predicts that democratization’s effects on public goods and growth are not uniform; they depend on population composition and the ease of occupational mobility through access to credit. Using a 37-year village-level panel from India (1971–2006) and exploiting variation in democratization driven by state and national reforms, we find strong support for these predictions. Financial intermediation shifts landless households’ preferences from wage-enhancing policies toward schooling, increasing nonfarm business entry. As a result, democracy provides fewer schools than oligarchy when credit is unavailable, but more schools when credit is accessible. We also show that transfers to the landless increase schooling under democracy but reduce it under oligarchy. These findings highlight how governance structures and economic conditions jointly determine the effectiveness of development policies.

35971.title: Coase Meets Negishi: Property Rights, Welfare Weights, and Distributional Consequences in Climate Economics
35971.zh_title: 科斯与根岸相遇：气候经济学中的产权、福利权重与分配后果
35971.authors: Simon F. Lang, Matthew D. Gordon, Matthew J. Kotchen
35971.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们提出一种基于产权的方法，用于在气候变化经济模型中定义福利权重。是否存在“污染权”或“不受污染权”在立法机构、法院和国际气候谈判中日益受到争议。我们展示了这些产权概念如何为适用于多边公共品情境的“科斯式福利权重”提供基础。分配问题通过实证分析加以处理，以产权为条件，而非基于关于再分配的规范性观点。隐含的转移支付与就应对气候变化的净收益达成的谈判解相一致，并反映了排放产权的价值。
35971.abstract: We develop a property-rights based approach for defining welfare weights in economic models of climate change. Whether there is a "right to pollute" or a "right to no pollution" is increasingly contested in legislatures, courts, and international climate negotiations. We show how these notions of property rights can provide the basis for "Coasean welfare weights" that are applicable in multilateral public goods settings. Distributional questions are addressed through positive analysis, conditional on property rights, rather than normative views about redistribution. The implied transfers are consistent with a bargained solution over the net benefits of addressing climate change and reflect the value of property rights over emissions. The approach defines efficient allocations that generate Pareto improvements, in contrast to commonly used Negishi weights. We implement the approach in a global integrated assessment model to quantify what countries have at stake in ongoing political and legal debates about emissions-related property rights.

35970.title: A Beckerian Theory of Taxation
35970.authors: Margaret Chen, Mikhail Golosov, Ilia Krasikov
35970.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究匹配环境中的税收问题，其中均衡排序和匹配剩余的分享均为内生。税制改革会导致整个经济中排序和剩余分享模式的复杂调整。我们开发了一种通用方法，利用匹配弹性来刻画这些均衡调整，匹配弹性是描述代理人匹配选择如何受局部均衡中货币收益影响的原始对象。将该方法应用于家庭形成的标准模型，我们首先表明排序和剩余分享反应与经济剩余创造中的互补性密切相关，正如Becker（1973）首次强调的那样。
35970.abstract: We study taxation in matching environments in which both equilibrium sorting and the sharing of match surplus are endogenous. Tax reforms lead to complex adjustments in sorting and surplus sharing patterns across the whole economy. We develop a general approach for characterizing these equilibrium adjustments using matching elasticities, which are primitive objects that describe how agents' matching choices are affected by pecuniary payoffs in partial equilibrium. Applying this approach to a workhorse model of family formation, we first show that the sorting and surplus sharing responses are closely linked to complementarities in the creation of economic surplus, as first emphasized by Becker (1973). We then describe the effects of arbitrary tax reforms on tax revenues, the utilities of different agents, and social welfare; design tests to assess Pareto efficiency of existing tax systems; derive formulas that characterize optimal taxes; and propose numerical techniques to compute them. In a calibrated model, we find that optimal marginal tax rates are substantially lower and less progressive than in the Mirrleesian benchmark.

35969.title: Pollution Monitoring and the Pricing of Environmental Risk in Firms
35969.zh_title: 污染监测与企业环境风险定价
35969.authors: Namrata Kala, Jalal Sani, Nemit Shroff, Pengdong Zhang
35969.zh_abstract_excerpt: 为企业环境风险定价对于确保资本有效配置至关重要。我们考察污染信息显著性的提高是否影响财务资深代理人——金融分析师——对其所覆盖企业面临的环境风险的信念和感知估值。利用中国环境空气质量监测计划的交错推广，我们表明当某城市引入监测时，位于该城市的分析师变得显著更可能讨论空气污染。这些注意力变化反映在股价中：受处理分析师发布的报告对棕色企业产生更负面的市场反应，对绿色企业产生更正面的反应，而对环境中性企业变化甚微。这些价格反应随后并未逆转。
35969.abstract: Pricing firms’ environmental risk is central to ensuring that capital is efficiently allocated. We examine whether an increase in the salience of pollution information affects the beliefs and perceived valuations of financially sophisticated agents—financial analysts—regarding the environmental risks faced by the firms they cover. Exploiting the staggered rollout of China's ambient air quality monitoring program, we show that when monitoring is introduced in a city, analysts based there become substantially more likely to discuss air pollution. These changes in attention are reflected in stock prices: reports issued by treated analysts generate more negative market reactions for brown firms and more positive reactions for green firms, with little change for environmentally neutral firms. These price responses do not subsequently reverse. Treated analysts increase their information acquisition through corporate site visits and issue less favorable assessments of brown firms and more favorable assessments of green firms. Our findings show that ambient environmental monitoring can affect asset prices by making environmental risks more salient and inducing greater information production about their implications for firm value.

35968.title: The Effects of Monetary Policy on Macroeconomic Expectations: High-Frequency Evidence from Prediction Markets
35968.zh_title: 货币政策对宏观经济预期的影响：来自预测市场的高频证据
35968.authors: Eric T. Swanson, Wang Renxuan, Yanbin Wu
35968.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当美联储加息时，标准宏观经济模型和VAR预测产出、就业和通胀应在未来几个季度下降。然而，月度频率的专业宏观经济预测修正有时与美联储利率变化正相关，引发了关于如何解释这些令人困惑的相关性的辩论。我们利用来自Kalshi的宏观经济事件合约的新高频数据来探讨这一问题，Kalshi是一家CFTC许可的、位于美国的事件交易交易所和预测市场。这些高频事件合约使我们能够分离和估计货币政策及其他公告对Kalshi市场隐含宏观经济预期的影响。
35968.abstract: When the Federal Reserve raises interest rates, standard macroeconomic models and VARs predict that output, employment, and inflation should fall over the next several quarters. However, monthly-frequency professional macroeconomic forecast revisions are sometimes positively correlated with Fed interest rate changes, leading to a debate about what could explain these puzzling correlations. We bring to bear new high-frequency data on this question from macroeconomic event contracts traded on Kalshi, a CFTC-licensed, U.S.-based event trading exchange and prediction market. These high-frequency event contracts allow us to isolate and estimate the effects of monetary policy and other announcements on Kalshi market-implied macroeconomic expectations. Our results are consistent with standard transmission channels from monetary policy to the macroeconomy, with little or no role for a “Fed Information Effect”.

35967.title: Aggregate-Surplus Maximizing Monetary Policy
35967.zh_title: 总剩余最大化的货币政策
35967.authors: David Baqaee, Ariel Burstein, Joao Guerreiro
35967.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究一般异质性代理人新凯恩斯（HANK）经济中的最优货币政策。政策制定者不是最大化社会福利函数，而是最大化所有家庭的联合剩余，不对该剩余应如何分配采取立场。这是使改革赢家补偿输家后剩余资源最大化的政策。我们使用线性-二次方法推导近似最优政策。二次目标函数嵌套了标准新凯恩斯损失函数，并增加了来自不完全市场和异质性劳动楔子的损失。我们表明最优政策是时间依赖成分和状态依存成分之和。
35967.abstract: We study optimal monetary policy in a general heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian (HANK) economy. Instead of maximizing a social welfare function, the policymaker maximizes the joint surplus of all households, without taking a stance on how that surplus should be distributed. This is the policy that maximizes resources left over if winners from reform were to compensate losers. We derive the approximate optimal policy using linear-quadratic methods. The quadratic objective function nests the standard New Keynesian loss function and adds losses from incomplete markets and heterogeneous labor wedges. We show that optimal policy is the sum of time-dependent and state-contingent components. When labor wedges are homogeneous, monetary policy cannot improve household insurance: the time-dependent component is zero, and optimal policy coincides with the representative-agent New Keynesian (RANK) benchmark. Departures from RANK arise from heterogeneous labor wedges. In that case, the time-dependent component temporarily alleviates incomplete-market distortions but vanishes over time. The state-contingent component solves a dual-mandate problem, as in RANK, but with a higher weight on output-gap stabilization relative to inflation stabilization. In a calibrated model, heterogeneous labor wedges raise this weight by about 37 percent. We also find that a dual mandate with this higher weight achieves almost all of the aggregate-surplus gains from the full optimal policy and requires no compensatory transfers between winners and losers.

35966.title: Public R&D and the Automation of Manufacturing: Evidence from the Space Race
35966.zh_title: 公共研发与制造业自动化：来自太空竞赛的证据
35966.authors: Apoorva Babbar, Shawn Kantor, Alexander Whalley, Jingyuan Zeng
35966.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文考察公共研发如何塑造冷战时期太空竞赛期间技术变革的方向及其对美国制造业的后果。虽然先前研究已记录了公共研发对创新和经济增长的影响，但关于使命导向的公共投资是否将创新引向自动化以及这如何影响劳动力市场，所知甚少。我们利用各行业和地区对NASA太空竞赛投资暴露度的差异，估计1947年至1992年公共研发对创新和制造业结果的影响。
35966.abstract: This paper examines how public research and development shaped the direction of technological change during the Cold War–era Space Race and its consequences for US manufacturing. While prior research has documented the effects of public R&D on innovation and economic growth, less is known about whether mission-oriented public investment directed innovation toward automation and how this affected labor markets. We exploit variation in exposure to NASA's Space Race investments across industries and locations to estimate the effects of public R&D on innovation and manufacturing outcomes from 1947 to 1992. Combining newly developed measures of automation in full-text patent data with historical evidence on government involvement in patenting, we show that NASA-sponsored patents are systematically more automation-intensive than non-NASA patents within the same technological classes. Industries and locations more exposed to Space Race activity experienced persistent declines in labor share, consistent with the diffusion of labor-saving technologies developed for space applications. In contrast, we find little evidence of systematic changes in skill composition. These findings show that mission-oriented public R&D can shape the direction of technological change and have lasting distributional consequences.
35966.zh_abstract: 本文考察公共研发如何塑造冷战时期太空竞赛期间技术变革的方向及其对美国制造业的后果。虽然先前研究已记录了公共研发对创新和经济增长的影响，但关于使命导向的公共投资是否将创新引向自动化以及这如何影响劳动力市场，所知甚少。我们利用各行业和地区对NASA太空竞赛投资暴露度的差异，估计1947年至1992年公共研发对创新和制造业结果的影响。结合新开发的专利全文数据自动化度量与政府参与专利的历史证据，我们表明NASA资助的专利在同一技术类别内系统性地比非NASA专利更具自动化密集性。更多暴露于太空竞赛活动的行业和地区经历了劳动份额的持续下降，这与为太空应用开发的节约劳动技术的扩散相一致。相比之下，我们几乎没有发现技能构成系统性变化的证据。这些发现表明，使命导向的公共研发可以塑造技术变革的方向并产生持久的分配后果。

35965.title: Income Inequality and Intergenerational Mobility in Russia: Trends, Sources, and Measurement
35965.zh_title: 俄罗斯的收入不平等与代际流动性：趋势、来源与测度
35965.authors: Kristina Butaeva, Steven N. Durlauf, Dmitry Rudenko
35965.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本章记录了从苏联解体到2025年俄罗斯收入与不平等的趋势，依据官方统计数据、现有文献和家庭调查微观数据。本章还回顾了代际流动性的证据。尽管人们一致认为不平等在1990年代急剧上升，但其2000年后的轨迹存在争议。早期的家庭调查研究通常发现不平等下降，而官方统计报告则显示基尼系数相对稳定。我们对俄罗斯主要家庭调查的分析——使用共同的测度惯例进行协调——与基于调查的文献一致，表明基尼系数总体上从2000年代初的约0.45–0.
35965.abstract: This chapter documents trends in income and inequality in Russia from the collapse of the Soviet Union through 2025, drawing on official statistics, the existing literature, and household survey microdata. It also reviews evidence on intergenerational mobility. While there is a consensus that inequality dramatically increased during the 1990s, its post-2000 trajectory is contested. Initial household survey studies usually found a decline, whereas official statistics reported a comparatively stable Gini coefficient. Our analysis of Russia's major household surveys, harmonized using common measurement conventions, aligns with the survey-based literature, indicating that the Gini coefficient generally fell from approximately 0.45–0.48 in the early 2000s to 0.29–0.38 in the early 2020s. We further find that most inequality arises within rather than between regions, urban and rural areas, and education and occupation groups. Household labor-market attachment, region, and household composition account for the largest shares of the explained variance in log income. The large literature on inequality is complemented by a small literature on intergenerational mobility. Here, the various studies on intergenerational dynamics in education, occupation, and income across post-Soviet cohorts conclude that, even against the background of dramatic structural changes, family background remains strongly associated with children’s outcomes.
35965.zh_abstract: 本章记录了从苏联解体到2025年俄罗斯收入与不平等的趋势，依据官方统计数据、现有文献和家庭调查微观数据。本章还回顾了代际流动性的证据。尽管人们一致认为不平等在1990年代急剧上升，但其2000年后的轨迹存在争议。早期的家庭调查研究通常发现不平等下降，而官方统计报告则显示基尼系数相对稳定。我们对俄罗斯主要家庭调查的分析——使用共同的测度惯例进行协调——与基于调查的文献一致，表明基尼系数总体上从2000年代初的约0.45–0.48下降到2020年代初的0.29–0.38。我们进一步发现，大多数不平等产生于地区、城乡以及教育和职业群体内部，而非它们之间。家庭劳动力市场依附、地区和家庭构成在对数收入的可解释方差中占最大份额。关于不平等的大量文献得到了关于代际流动性的少量文献的补充。在这里，关于后苏联各队列在教育、职业和收入方面代际动态的各种研究得出结论：即使在剧烈结构变化的背景下，家庭背景仍然与子女的结果强烈相关。

35964.title: Saving for the Machines
35964.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当机器能够执行越来越大份额的任务时，增长取决于两个边际：任务结构如何影响积累机器的回报，以及资本积累对这些回报的响应有多强。我认为，在标准任务模型中，资本供给决定与自动化相关的增长繁荣的规模，而任务结构决定这一增长繁荣的持续时间以及工资的演变。我记录了同一条技术路径在家庭最优选择储蓄率时产生11.7%的年增长率，而当储蓄率固定在校准的美国2025年水平23%时，仅带来2.2%的年增长率。
35964.abstract: When machines can perform a growing share of tasks, growth depends on two margins: how the task structure affects the returns to accumulating machines, and how strongly capital accumulation responds to those returns. I argue that, in a standard task model, capital supply governs the size of the growth boom associated with automation, while the task structure sets the duration of this growth boom and the evolution of wages. I document how the same technology path that generates 11.7% annual growth when households choose their saving rate optimally delivers only 2.2% when the saving rate is fixed at the calibrated U.S. 2025 level of 23%. Therefore, slow growth might reflect too little capital accumulation instead of a technological bottleneck. Also, the saving rate rises mainly because automation raises the capital share, not because households become thriftier. Long yields price the growth boom: the ten-year real yield jumps from 5.1% to 13.6% on impact. In my benchmark calibration, hand-to-mouth households lose the equivalent of two-fifths to two-thirds of their consumption, while keeping them on trend temporarily costs at most a fifth of GDP.
35964.zh_abstract: 当机器能够执行越来越大份额的任务时，增长取决于两个边际：任务结构如何影响积累机器的回报，以及资本积累对这些回报的响应有多强。我认为，在标准任务模型中，资本供给决定与自动化相关的增长繁荣的规模，而任务结构决定这一增长繁荣的持续时间以及工资的演变。我记录了同一条技术路径在家庭最优选择储蓄率时产生11.7%的年增长率，而当储蓄率固定在校准的美国2025年水平23%时，仅带来2.2%的年增长率。因此，缓慢增长可能反映的是资本积累过少，而不是技术瓶颈。此外，储蓄率上升主要是因为自动化提高了资本份额，而不是因为家庭变得更节俭。长期收益率对增长繁荣进行定价：十年期实际收益率在冲击下从5.1%跃升至13.6%。在我的基准校准中，手到口家庭损失相当于其消费的五分之二到三分之二，而使他们暂时保持在趋势上最多花费GDP的五分之一。

35963.title: Affirmative Action, Faculty Productivity and Caste Interactions: Evidence from Engineering Colleges in India
35963.zh_title: 平权行动、教师生产率与种姓互动：来自印度工程学院的证据
35963.authors: Robert W. Fairlie, Saurabh Khanna, Prashant Loyalka, Gagandeep S. Sachdeva
35963.zh_abstract_excerpt: 平权行动项目常常因为担心其导致劳动者生产率下降和效率损失而受到批评。我们研究在一个雇主被强制实施招聘约束且这些约束通常很可能具有约束力的环境中，受益于激进平权行动政策的劳动者的相对生产率。在印度，学院被要求将大约50%的教师招聘名额保留给来自弱势种姓和社会阶层群体的个人。我们收集并分析了来自印度50所工程与技术学院全国代表性样本的数据，其中一些学院随机将学生分配到教室。
35963.abstract: Affirmative action programs are often criticized because of concerns that they result in lower worker productivity and efficiency losses. We study the relative productivity of workers benefiting from an aggressive affirmative action policy in a setting where hiring constraints are mandated upon employers and are typically likely to bind. In India, colleges are required to reserve approximately 50 percent of faculty hires for individuals from disadvantaged caste and social class groups. We collect and analyze data from a nationally representative sample of 50 engineering and technology colleges in India, some of which randomly assign students to classrooms. We find that reservation category faculty have lower levels of education, lower professorial ranks and fewer years of experience in academia than general category faculty who are not hired through reservations. Yet, even with lower qualifications, we do not detect meaningful differences in instructional quality between reservation category faculty and general category faculty across a wide range of measures that include course grades, follow-on course grades, standardized test scores, dropout, attendance, graduate school plans, and graduation. In fact, we find that, at least for immediate effects on course grades, students taught by reservation category faculty perform slightly better than students taught by general category faculty. We also estimate “teacher-like-me” effects of reservation category faculty on the relative course performance and longer-term outcomes of reservation category students and cannot reject the hypothesis of null effects. Furthermore, even in the face of potential discrimination and resentment against faculty hiring quotas, general category students perform slightly better in classrooms taught by reservation category faculty than general category faculty. Finally, estimates of differences between reservation category and general category faculty in several measures of research productivity and administrative service are small in magnitude and not statistically different from zero. The findings have implications for the heated debates over affirmative action programs found in many countries around the world and in India which is now the largest country in the world.
35963.zh_abstract: 平权行动项目常常因为担心其导致劳动者生产率下降和效率损失而受到批评。我们研究在一个雇主被强制实施招聘约束且这些约束通常很可能具有约束力的环境中，受益于激进平权行动政策的劳动者的相对生产率。在印度，学院被要求将大约50%的教师招聘名额保留给来自弱势种姓和社会阶层群体的个人。我们收集并分析了来自印度50所工程与技术学院全国代表性样本的数据，其中一些学院随机将学生分配到教室。我们发现，保留类别教师的教育水平较低、教授职级较低，且在学术界的工作年限少于非通过保留招聘的一般类别教师。然而，即使资历较低，我们在包括课程成绩、后续课程成绩、标准化考试成绩、辍学、出勤、研究生院计划和毕业在内的广泛指标中，未检测到保留类别教师与一般类别教师在教学质量上的有意义差异。事实上，我们发现，至少就课程成绩的即时效应而言，由保留类别教师教授的学生表现略好于由一般类别教师教授的学生。我们还估计了保留类别教师对保留类别学生相对课程表现和较长期结果的“像我一样的教师”效应，并且不能拒绝零效应的假设。此外，即使面对针对教师招聘配额的潜在歧视和怨恨，一般类别学生在由保留类别教师教授的课堂中表现略好于由一般类别教师教授的课堂。最后，保留类别与一般类别教师在若干研究生产率和行政服务指标上的差异估计幅度很小，且与零在统计上无差异。这些发现对世界上许多国家以及印度——现在是世界上人口最多的国家——关于平权行动项目的激烈辩论具有启示意义。

35962.title: Unraveling the Cobweb of Global Imbalances: Drivers, Vulnerabilities and Adjustment Scenarios
35962.zh_title: 解开全球失衡的蛛网：驱动因素、脆弱性与调整情景
35962.authors: Stefan Avdjiev, Kristin Forbes, Tsvetelina Nenova, Marjorie Santos
35962.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文分析全球失衡存量的演变和驱动因素，以评估相关脆弱性和潜在调整情景。这些失衡最近急剧增加，美国净国际投资头寸（NIIP）恶化，而大多数其他主要经济体的NIIP改善。我们对28个经济体的样本将这些NIIP变化分解为其直接驱动因素，发现金融因素（包括估值变化和投资收入流）在短期和长期都是全球失衡的主要驱动因素，而贸易也发挥重要作用（尤其是在长期）。
35962.abstract: This paper analyses the evolution and drivers of the stock of global imbalances in order to assess associated vulnerabilities and potential adjustment scenarios. These imbalances have recently increased sharply, with a deterioration in the US net international investment position (NIIP) mirrored by NIIP improvements in most other major economies. We decompose these NIIP changes into their proximate drivers for a sample of 28 economies and find that financial factors (including valuation changes and investment income flows) are the primary drivers of global imbalances at both short and long horizons, while trade also plays a significant role (especially at long horizons). Valuation gains on international investment positions have supported economic growth in many countries since 2010, while also increasing their vulnerability to financial market adjustments. To assess the implications and potential risks, we simulate the spillovers through this cobweb of global imbalances from: (i) a sharp dollar depreciation, (ii) a repricing of equity markets, (iii) higher interest rates, and (iv) a halving of trade imbalances. These scenarios highlight the large international spillovers that would be associated with any reduction in global imbalances, the heterogeneous impact of various rebalancing mechanisms on individual countries and the limits of popular proposals for reducing these imbalances. The persistence of global imbalances underscores the importance of building resilience to the large spillovers that can occur through this cobweb of international exposures.
35962.zh_abstract: 本文分析全球失衡存量的演变和驱动因素，以评估相关脆弱性和潜在调整情景。这些失衡最近急剧增加，美国净国际投资头寸（NIIP）恶化，而大多数其他主要经济体的NIIP改善。我们对28个经济体的样本将这些NIIP变化分解为其直接驱动因素，发现金融因素（包括估值变化和投资收入流）在短期和长期都是全球失衡的主要驱动因素，而贸易也发挥重要作用（尤其是在长期）。自2010年以来，国际投资头寸的估值收益支撑了许多国家的经济增长，同时也增加了它们对金融市场调整的脆弱性。为了评估影响和潜在风险，我们模拟了通过这一全球失衡蛛网传导的溢出效应，情景包括：(i) 美元大幅贬值，(ii) 股票市场重新定价，(iii) 利率上升，以及 (iv) 贸易失衡减半。这些情景凸显了任何全球失衡减少都会伴随的巨大国际溢出效应、各种再平衡机制对单个国家的异质性影响，以及减少这些失衡的流行提案的局限性。全球失衡的持续性凸显了建立韧性以应对可能通过这一国际敞口蛛网发生的大规模溢出效应的重要性。

35961.title: Can Home Visits Re-Engage Chronically Absent Students? Evidence from the LEAP Program
35961.zh_title: 家访能否重新吸引长期缺勤学生？来自LEAP项目的证据
35961.authors: Eric Brunner, Shangyue Jiang, Stephen Ross
35961.zh_abstract_excerpt: 从2021年夏季开始，康涅狄格州启动了学习者参与和出勤项目（LEAP），由学校人员对康涅狄格州15个最弱势学区中被认定为长期缺勤的学生进行家访。家访旨在将学生及其家庭直接与教师联系起来，以培养牢固的联系。我们使用2021–22至2023-24的学生层面数据，估计LEAP对学生出勤、长期缺勤、纪律事件和学生成绩影响的事件研究。
35961.abstract: Beginning in the summer of 2021, the state of Connecticut launched the Learner Engagement and Attendance Program (LEAP) where home visits by school personnel were conducted with students identified as chronically absent from Connecticut’s 15 most disadvantaged school districts. Home visits were designed to connect students and their families directly with teachers to foster strong connections. We use student-level data from 2021–22 through 2023-24 to estimate event studies of the effect of LEAP on student attendance, chronic absenteeism, disciplinary incidents, and student achievement. Utilizing models that address selection into treatment timing over student observable and unobservable attributes, we find that students who received the LEAP intervention experienced approximately a 4 to 5 percentage point increase in attendance rates, a 13 to 15 percentage point decline in chronic absenteeism, and a 3 to 5 percentage point decline in the number of disciplinary incidents. Notably, initial event studies indicated increasing treatment effects over time, but after correcting for selection on unobservables treatment effects appeared constant over time. These effects were broad based, with similar impacts by gender, race and ethnicity, and free or reduced-price lunch status. These attendance and discipline results provide suggest that the LEAP intervention increased student noncognitive skills.
35961.zh_abstract: 从2021年夏季开始，康涅狄格州启动了学习者参与和出勤项目（LEAP），由学校人员对康涅狄格州15个最弱势学区中被认定为长期缺勤的学生进行家访。家访旨在将学生及其家庭直接与教师联系起来，以培养牢固的联系。我们使用2021–22至2023-24的学生层面数据，估计LEAP对学生出勤、长期缺勤、纪律事件和学生成绩影响的事件研究。利用处理学生可观察和不可观察属性上的处理时点选择问题的模型，我们发现接受LEAP干预的学生出勤率提高约4至5个百分点，长期缺勤下降13至15个百分点，纪律事件数量下降3至5个百分点。值得注意的是，初始事件研究显示处理效应随时间增加，但在校正不可观察因素的选择后，处理效应似乎随时间保持不变。这些效应具有广泛基础，按性别、种族和族裔以及免费或减价午餐状况的影响相似。这些出勤和纪律结果表明LEAP干预提高了学生的非认知技能。

35999.title: (In)Credible Development RCTs: False Discoveries, Low Power, and a Solution
35999.zh_title: （不）可信的发展经济学随机对照试验：错误发现、低统计功效及一种解决方案
35999.authors: Qingyuan Chai, Kevin Lang, Liang Zhong
35999.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究发展经济学中随机对照试验（RCT）的统计可信度，以及将资源最优配置于重复实验的问题。利用来自领先经济学期刊190篇文章的745个主假设检验，我们发现实际t统计量的峰值远低于在80%统计功效下预期的理论基准2.8，但高于与p值操纵相关的数值。这表明许多RCT统计功效不足。通过估计一个考虑选择性发表的经验贝叶斯混合模型，我们发现约30%的已发表拒绝原假设是错误发现，平均方向性功效仅为40%。
35999.abstract: We study the statistical credibility of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in development economics and the optimal allocation of resources to replication. Using 745 principal-hypothesis tests from 190 articles in leading economics journals, we find that actual t-statistics peak well below the theoretical benchmark of 2.8 expected under 80 percent power, though above values associated with p-hacking. This suggests many RCTs are underpowered. Estimating an empirical Bayes mixture model that accounts for selective publication, we find that approximately 30 percent of published rejections are false discoveries, with average directional power at only 40 percent. At conventional significance thresholds, the posterior probability of a false discovery reaches 66 percent. Doubling original sample sizes lowers the average false discovery rate by five percentage points, whereas tightening the significance threshold to 0.005 yields a larger reduction at the cost of total discoveries. Finally, we characterize a funder’s optimal replication policy under a fixed budget and an evidence standard. Under standard regularity conditions, replications concentrate in an intermediate interval of original test statistics, and the optimal replication sample size is single-peaked in the original t-statistic. Illustrative calibrations show that successful replications reduce aggregate false discovery rates to 1.8–7.8 percent, depending on the evidence standard.
35999.zh_abstract: 我们研究发展经济学中随机对照试验（RCT）的统计可信度，以及将资源最优配置于重复实验的问题。利用来自领先经济学期刊190篇文章的745个主假设检验，我们发现实际t统计量的峰值远低于在80%统计功效下预期的理论基准2.8，但高于与p值操纵相关的数值。这表明许多RCT统计功效不足。通过估计一个考虑选择性发表的经验贝叶斯混合模型，我们发现约30%的已发表拒绝原假设是错误发现，平均方向性功效仅为40%。在常规显著性阈值下，错误发现的后验概率达到66%。将原始样本量翻倍可使平均错误发现率降低5个百分点，而将显著性阈值收紧至0.005则可在牺牲总发现数量的代价下带来更大的降低。最后，我们刻画了在固定预算和证据标准下资助者的最优重复实验政策。在标准正则条件下，重复实验集中于原始检验统计量的中间区间，且最优重复实验样本量关于原始t统计量呈单峰。示例性校准显示，成功的重复实验可将总体错误发现率降至1.8%–7.8%，具体取决于证据标准。

35998.title: Sorting by Participation: A Field Experiment in a Stem-cell Registry
35998.zh_title: 通过参与进行筛选：干细胞登记处的一项实地实验
35998.authors: Michael Haylock, Patrick Kampkötter, Mario Macis, Susanne Seitz, Robert Slonim, Daniel Wiesen
35998.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在确认分型（CT）阶段——干细胞捐献过程中的一个操作性里程碑——干细胞捐献者的不可用性，减少了全球血癌患者获得救命移植的有效供给。尽管（潜在）捐献者是自愿登记的，但请求可能在很久之后才到来，此时情况和承诺已经改变；因此，保持登记捐献者的参与并识别谁会真正履约，是登记处的核心管理问题。我们与一家领先的干细胞登记处开展实地实验，随机化常规邀请参与一项参与倡议的框架表述。相对于常规信函，我们的实验信函更突出地呈现登记处的请求；
35998.abstract: Unavailability of stem-cell donors at the confirmatory typing (CT) stage, an operational milestone in the stem-cell donation process, reduces the effective supply of life-saving transplants for blood cancer patients worldwide. Although (potential) donors register voluntarily, requests may come much later, when circumstances and commitment have changed; keeping registered donors engaged and identifying who will follow through are therefore central managerial questions for registries. In a field experiment with a leading stem-cell registry, we randomize the framing of routine invitations to an engagement initiative. Relative to a business-as-usual letter, our experimental letters present the registry’s requests more saliently; two of them add identity framings inviting donors to join a “quickly available” or a “highly committed” donor team. The salience and identity framings significantly reduce initiative participation compared to the business-as-usual rate, yet intention-to-treat analyses show no detectable effect on average CT availability. Our central finding is that participation sorts donors by reliability: participants are unavailable in 12% of cases, versus 30% of non-participants. From a managerial perspective, opting in works as a reliability flag. Prioritizing participants in our experimental arms implies a relative increase of up to 7.5% more one-year survivors compared to not using this flag. Gains from flagging are likely to be larger for registries with lower availability.
35998.zh_abstract: 在确认分型（CT）阶段——干细胞捐献过程中的一个操作性里程碑——干细胞捐献者的不可用性，减少了全球血癌患者获得救命移植的有效供给。尽管（潜在）捐献者是自愿登记的，但请求可能在很久之后才到来，此时情况和承诺已经改变；因此，保持登记捐献者的参与并识别谁会真正履约，是登记处的核心管理问题。我们与一家领先的干细胞登记处开展实地实验，随机化常规邀请参与一项参与倡议的框架表述。相对于常规信函，我们的实验信函更突出地呈现登记处的请求；其中两封增加了身份框架，邀请捐献者加入“快速可用”或“高度承诺”的捐献者团队。与常规比率相比，突出性和身份框架显著降低了倡议参与率，然而意向性治疗分析显示对平均CT可用性没有可检测的影响。我们的核心发现是，参与按可靠性对捐献者进行筛选：参与者在12%的情况下不可用，而非参与者为30%。从管理角度看，选择加入起到了可靠性标志的作用。在我们的实验组中优先考虑参与者，意味着与不使用该标志相比，一年存活者相对增加最多7.5%。对于可用性较低的登记处，标志带来的收益可能更大。

35997.title: Beyond Overdose Prevention: Naloxone Coprescription Laws and the Path to Treatment
35997.zh_title: 超越过量预防：纳洛酮共同处方法律与通往治疗之路
35997.authors: Shin-Yi Chou, Jiarun Li, Bingjin Xue
35997.zh_abstract_excerpt: 美国超过三分之一的州已颁布纳洛酮共同处方法律，要求医生在开具高风险阿片类药物时同时开具或提供纳洛酮。利用Medicare Part D数据、治疗事件数据集以及双重差分设计，我们研究这些法律如何影响纳洛酮获取、更广泛的处方行为以及治疗参与。共同处方法律使纳洛酮处方量增加了275%，在要求开具处方的州，效果是仅要求提供纳洛酮的州的两倍。
35997.abstract: Over one-third of U.S. states have enacted naloxone coprescription laws, requiring physicians to prescribe or offer naloxone alongside high-risk opioids. Using Medicare Part D data, the Treatment Episode Data Set, and a difference-in-differences design, we study how these laws affect naloxone access, broader prescription behavior, and treatment engagement. Coprescription laws increased naloxone prescribing by 275%, with effects twice as large in states requiring prescriptions as in those requiring only offers. We find no evidence of increased opioid or benzodiazepine prescribing, countering moral hazard concerns that broader naloxone access might encourage riskier opioid use. Instead, we document significant increases in prescribing of medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and gains in opioid use disorder treatment admissions, primarily in deliberate treatment-seeking settings. These results suggest that coprescription laws may have broader benefits beyond overdose prevention.
35997.zh_abstract: 美国超过三分之一的州已颁布纳洛酮共同处方法律，要求医生在开具高风险阿片类药物时同时开具或提供纳洛酮。利用Medicare Part D数据、治疗事件数据集以及双重差分设计，我们研究这些法律如何影响纳洛酮获取、更广泛的处方行为以及治疗参与。共同处方法律使纳洛酮处方量增加了275%，在要求开具处方的州，效果是仅要求提供纳洛酮的州的两倍。我们没有发现阿片类药物或苯二氮䓬类药物处方增加的证据，这反驳了更广泛的纳洛酮获取可能鼓励更高风险阿片类药物使用的道德风险担忧。相反，我们记录了阿片类药物使用障碍药物（MOUD）处方的显著增加以及阿片类药物使用障碍治疗入院人数的增长，主要发生在有意寻求治疗的环境中。这些结果表明，共同处方法律可能具有超越过量预防的更广泛益处。

35996.title: When Food Stamps Became Free: Impacts and Implications of Removing the Purchase Requirement
35996.zh_title: 当食品券变为免费：取消购买要求的影響与启示
35996.authors: Amy Finkelstein, Matthew J. Notowidigdo, Charlie Rafkin
35996.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过研究1979年使食品券变为免费的改革，将食品券计划既作为对儿童健康资本的潜在投资，又作为再分配工具进行分析。我们利用该改革暴露程度的地理差异，该改革将计划的食品补贴从65%提高到100%。这使登记人数增加了1.85个百分点（标准误=0.15），约25%，新登记者的贫困程度远高于现有参与者。从投资角度看，我们没有发现婴儿健康改善的证据，95%置信区间排除了登记食品券带来的出生体重增加超过2%的可能性。
35996.abstract: We analyze the food stamp program both as a potential investment in children’s health capital and as a redistributive tool by studying the 1979 reform that made food stamps free. We leverage geographic variation in exposure to the reform, which raised the program’s food subsidy from 65% to 100%. This raised enrollment by 1.85 percentage points (standard error = 0.15), or about 25%, with new enrollees substantially poorer than existing participants. From an investment perspective, we do not find evidence of improvement in infant health, and 95% confidence intervals rule out gains in birth weight from enrolling in food stamps exceeding 2%. From a redistribution perspective, the enrollment response implies that the average recipient of free food stamps acts as if they value them at 59 cents per dollar, with nonparametric bounds of 42–77 cents. Despite this substantial dissipation in transfer value relative to a frictionless cash transfer, under standard redistributive preferences the free food stamp program increases social welfare because of its targeting to very low-income households. The move to free stamps from a partially subsidized program improved targeting on social value but worsened targeting on private value.

35994.title: The Impact of Climate Change on Fisheries
35994.zh_title: 气候变化对渔业的影响
35994.authors: Fabio Cevenini, Christopher Costello, Carlo Fezzi
35994.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文首次提供了海洋温度变化对渔业收入影响的因果估计。我们构建了一个简单的理论模型，作为实证设定的基础，该设定基于2013–2022年所有欧洲船只250万个空间明确的渔业收入观测值进行估计。识别策略利用了一个新指标——海洋度日，该指标量化了相对于生物学确立的热耐受区间的物种特定温度暴露。在此框架内，我们解决了关键的识别挑战，包括空间选择和物种间的生态相互依赖。我们发现，偏离物种的热偏好会导致渔业收入的显著损失，其中热暴露造成的影响最为显著。
35994.abstract: This paper provides the first causal estimate of the effect of ocean temperature variations on fishing revenue. We develop a simple theoretical model underpinning an empirical specification estimated on 2.5 million spatially explicit observations of fishing revenue from all European vessels for 2013–2022. The identification strategy leverages a novel metric, Marine Degree Days, which quantifies species-specific temperature exposure relative to biologically established thermal tolerance intervals. Within this framework we address key identification challenges, including spatial selection and ecological interdependencies across species. We find that deviations from species’ thermal preferences lead to significant losses in fishing revenue, with heat exposure causing the most pronounced impacts. These effects are mediated by species’ vertical mobility and ecological characteristics. Projections across different climate scenarios point to widespread revenue declines by 2100, reaching €560 million annual losses in the warmest scenario, though impacts are highly spatially heterogeneous. Lower-income, equatorial areas are expected to suffer the most, while some colder regions experience gains.

35993.title: Peer Influence in College Applications
35993.zh_title: 大学申请中的同伴影响
35993.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究接触同伴如何影响大学申请行为。我们利用就读不同高中的邻居来缓解对共同冲击的担忧。利用细粒度的班级层面数据，我们发现接触曾申请某个项目的同伴会提高申请率。与信息机制一致，被录取的同伴没有额外效应。在反事实分析中，该效应大到足以缩小选择性大学项目申请中的城乡差距和性别差距。我们利用一个录取概率可观测且条件独立的设定，使（通常为NP难的）申请组合选择问题变得可处理。
35993.abstract: This paper studies how exposure to peers affects college application behavior. We use neighbors who attend different high schools to mitigate concerns about common shocks. Using granular classroom-level data, we find that exposure to peers who have applied to a program increases application rates. Consistent with an information mechanism, there is no additional effect of peers who are admitted. In counterfactuals, the effect is large enough to close urban-rural gaps and gender gaps in applications to selective college programs. We make the (generally NP-hard) application portfolio choice problem tractable using a setting where admission probabilities are observable and conditionally independent.

35992.title: Policy Deterrence: Strategic Investment in U.S. Broadband
35992.zh_title: 政策威慑：美国宽带领域的战略投资
35992.zh_abstract_excerpt: 企业能否通过投资影响政策？利用2010--2019年美国宽带部署和州级政策数据，我们发现大型互联网服务提供商在选举竞争激烈的县扩张容量的幅度更大。摇摆县中大型提供商容量越大，随后出台的促进进入和投资的政策越少，尤其是减少小型提供商部署障碍的路权便利政策。为解释这些模式，我们构建了一个模型，其中大型企业的容量会降低政策制定者从干预中获得的收益。在该模型中，政策威慑提高了大型企业的市场份额，并可能减少总部署量。
35992.abstract: Can firms influence policy through investment? Using 2010--2019 U.S. broadband deployment and state policy data, we find that large internet service providers expand capacity more in electorally competitive counties. Greater large-provider capacity in swing counties is associated with fewer subsequent entry- and investment-facilitating policies, especially rights-of-way accommodations that reduce deployment barriers faced by smaller providers. To interpret these patterns, we develop a model in which a large firm's capacity can reduce the policymaker's gain from intervention. In the model, policy deterrence raises the large firm's market share and can reduce total deployment.

35991.title: Doing Better at Doing Good: Lessons from a Bayesian Meta-Analysis After 20 Years of Poverty Graduation Programs
35991.zh_title: 在行善上做得更好：20年扶贫毕业项目后的贝叶斯元分析经验
35991.authors: Samantha Carter, Edward Jee, Dean Karlan, Patrick Premand
35991.zh_abstract_excerpt: 旨在增加低收入家庭创收活动的多维度扶贫毕业项目正被非营利组织和政府迅速采用并扩大规模。本文对49项研究（涵盖81种处理变体）进行了贝叶斯分层元分析，这些研究涉及扶贫毕业项目，其定义为至少包含五个组成部分中的三个：消费支持、储蓄便利、技能培训、辅导和一次性转移支付。分析发现经济和社会心理结果均有大幅改善：月度消费增加38美元PPP（11%），收入增加28美元PPP（15%），同时储蓄、资产、粮食安全、心理健康和妇女赋权也有所改善。
35991.abstract: Multifaceted poverty Graduation programs that aim to increase income generating activities for low-income households are being rapidly adopted and scaled by nonprofit organizations and governments. This paper conducts a Bayesian hierarchical meta-analysis of 49 studies (encompassing 81 treatment variations) on poverty Graduation programs, defined as containing at least three of five components: consumption support, savings facilitation, skills training, coaching, and a lumpsum transfer. The analysis finds large gains across economic and psychosocial outcomes: monthly consumption rises by 38 USD PPP (11 percent), income by 28 USD PPP (15 percent), alongside improvements in savings, assets, food security, mental health, and women’s empowerment. Beyond these average treatment effects, three results stand out. First, programs with large transfers (at least 400 USD PPP) have larger treatment effects but are not more cost-effective. Second, more expensive programs generate larger treatment effects, but the improvements are not commensurate with the cost increases; thus, lower cost programs tend to be more cost-effective. Third, programs implemented from 2016 onward perform considerably better than those implemented prior to 2016: benefit-cost ratios from 2016 onward are 5.39, compared to 2.89 through 2015. Neither changes in cost nor in high-level design (components) explain this upward trend. Considering other heavily studied interventions, the results show a similar upward trend for treatment effects on behavior change from financial education but not for unconditional cash transfers. The paper hypothesizes a mechanism of continuous sector-community learning and improved implementation quality.
35991.zh_abstract: 旨在增加低收入家庭创收活动的多维度扶贫毕业项目正被非营利组织和政府迅速采用并扩大规模。本文对49项研究（涵盖81种处理变体）进行了贝叶斯分层元分析，这些研究涉及扶贫毕业项目，其定义为至少包含五个组成部分中的三个：消费支持、储蓄便利、技能培训、辅导和一次性转移支付。分析发现经济和社会心理结果均有大幅改善：月度消费增加38美元PPP（11%），收入增加28美元PPP（15%），同时储蓄、资产、粮食安全、心理健康和妇女赋权也有所改善。除这些平均处理效应外，有三项结果尤为突出。第一，转移支付规模较大（至少400美元PPP）的项目处理效应更大，但成本效益并不更高。第二，成本更高的项目产生更大的处理效应，但改善幅度与成本增加不成比例；因此，低成本项目往往更具成本效益。第三，2016年及以后实施的项目表现明显优于2016年之前实施的项目：2016年及以后的效益成本比为5.39，而截至2015年为2.89。成本变化和高层设计（组成部分）变化均无法解释这一上升趋势。考虑其他被大量研究的干预措施，结果显示金融教育对行为改变的处理效应存在类似上升趋势，但无条件现金转移支付则没有。本文提出一个机制假设：持续的行业-社区学习和实施质量改善。

35990.title: Financial Advisors and Retirees' Risk-taking
35990.zh_title: 财务顾问与退休人员的风险承担
35990.authors: Allison T. Cole, Maarten Meeuwis, Alessandro Previtero, Noah Stoffman
35990.zh_abstract_excerpt: 接受顾问建议的退休人员在步入老年后仍将约三分之二的资产组合配置于股票——比未接受建议的退休人员、目标日期基金或常见经验法则高出30至40个百分点。这些配置反映的是主动选择而非惯性，并且在更换顾问后会逐渐调整至新顾问的投资风格。股票份额随关系持续时间上升，且顾问影响力在金融知识或风险承受能力较低的客户中最强，这与信任促进风险承担相一致。
35990.abstract: Advised retirees keep about two-thirds of their portfolios in equities well into old age—30 to 40 percentage points more than non-advised retirees, target-date funds, or common rules of thumb. These allocations reflect active choices rather than inertia, and they adjust gradually toward a new advisor’s investment style following advisor switches. Equity shares rise with relationship tenure, and advisor influence is strongest among clients with low financial knowledge or risk tolerance, consistent with trust facilitating risk-taking. Given retirees’ modest financial wealth relative to their safe pension income, we rationalize these portfolios in a standard life-cycle model with moderate risk aversion. Modeling advisors as “money doctors” who correct clients’ pessimistic beliefs about the equity premium, we find that, relative to a no-advice counterfactual, the welfare gains from higher risk-taking are of the same order of magnitude as the cost of advice.

35989.title: Clearing the Fog: Price Transparency, Market Churn, and Consumer Welfare in Short-Term Rentals
35989.zh_title: 拨开迷雾：短期租赁中的价格透明度、市场更替与消费者福利
35989.authors: Ginger Zhe Jin, Liad Wagman, Jingyi Xing
35989.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究了加利福尼亚州短期住宿价格透明法（AB 537），该法自2024年7月1日起要求Airbnb和其他提供商宣传含费用的价格。使用粗化精确匹配将圣地亚哥和旧金山的Airbnb房源与西雅图和芝加哥的房源进行比较，我们发现全包定价使客人相对于对照城市对价格更敏感；然而，与透明度降低价格的标准预测相反，平均每日房价上涨了4.8%。
35989.abstract: We study California's short-term lodging price transparency law (AB 537), which from July 1, 2024 required Airbnb and other providers to advertise fee-inclusive prices. Using Coarsened Exact Matching to compare Airbnb listings in San Diego and San Francisco with those in Seattle and Chicago, we find that all-in pricing made guests more price-sensitive relative to control cities; yet, contrary to the standard prediction that transparency lowers prices, average daily rates rose by 4.8 percent. We also observe significant market churn: relative to control cities, treated cities saw more exits and entries, listings reliant on cleaning-fee revenue disproportionately exited, higher-quality listings were more likely to stay, and entrants offered lower fees and lower quality than incumbents. A discrete-choice welfare analysis shows that the law removed a sizable “welfare illusion” created by obscured fees and, largely through market churn, raised realized consumer surplus. The net gains, after accounting for price increases, were positive on average but unevenly distributed across treated ZIP codes.

35988.title: The Hidden Sharpe Ratio
35988.authors: Mikhail Chernov, Bryan T. Kelly, Semyon Malamud, Johannes Schwab
35988.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们直接估计大型资产横截面中的最大夏普比率，而无需构建有效投资组合。在这种情形下，协方差估计需要正则化，这会抑制小特征值方向的贡献。我们的估计量逐步恢复这一贡献，产生带有渐近置信区间的紧致上下界。我们进一步表明，岭正则化Markowitz投资组合——许多现有高夏普基准所基于的构建方式——其样本外夏普比率低于真实最大值一个明确的、非消失的乘数因子。应用于美国股票，该方法给出的估计最大年化夏普比率约为7.4，排除微型股后为5.
35988.abstract: We estimate the maximal Sharpe ratio in large cross-sections of assets directly, without constructing the efficient portfolio. Covariance estimation in this setting requires regularization, which suppresses the contribution of small-eigenvalue directions. Our estimator progressively recovers this contribution, yielding tight upper and lower bounds with asymptotic confidence intervals. We further show that ridge-regularized Markowitz portfolios, the construction underlying many existing high-Sharpe benchmarks, deliver out-of-sample Sharpe ratios that fall short of the true maximum by an explicit, non-vanishing multiplicative factor. Applied to U.S. equities, the method delivers an estimated maximal annualized Sharpe ratio of approximately 7.4, or 5.0 once micro-cap stocks are excluded, substantially exceeding existing portfolio-based benchmarks of 1.0–4.0. Adding corporate bonds raises the maximum, though not by a statistically significant margin. Nonlinear portfolio weights dominate linear ones, and characteristics introduced after 2004 contribute little additional Sharpe ratio.

35987.title: TaskNet: Building Occupational Task Inventories from Worker Interviews at Scale
35987.zh_title: TaskNet：通过大规模工人访谈构建职业任务清单
35987.authors: Jennifer Wang, Andreas Haupt, Isaac Robinson, Phil Lewis, Erik Brynjolfsson, Diyi Yang
35987.zh_abstract_excerpt: 理解AI如何重塑工作需要准确记录工人所执行的任务。工人往往最先看到自己的工作如何变化，因为新的职责和工具常常先出现在日常工作中，之后才进入正式描述。与工人的访谈有助于捕捉这些正在出现的任务变化。然而，现有方法支持对工人进行标准化评分，而与工人的开放式对话在大规模收集和综合方面仍然成本高昂。我们引入斯坦福任务网络（TaskNet），这是一个直接基于工人对日常工作叙述的职业分类体系。
35987.abstract: Understanding how AI is reshaping work requires an accurate account of the tasks workers perform. Workers are often the first to see how their jobs are changing, as new responsibilities and tools often appear in everyday work before these changes reach formal descriptions. Interviews with workers can help capture these emerging changes in job tasks. Yet existing methods support standardized ratings across workers, while open-ended conversations with workers remain costly to collect and synthesize at scale. We introduce the Stanford Task Network (TaskNet), an occupational taxonomy grounded directly in workers’ accounts of their everyday work. To construct TaskNet, we develop a mixed-initiative system that induces task inventories directly from workers. The system conducts interviews, standardizes reports into individual task lists, and aggregates these lists into occupational task inventories. Applied to six occupations spanning a range of education requirements and AI exposure, our system interviews 132 workers and produces 202 task statements from 2726 reports, all of which were accepted by O*NET Center analysts, compared to roughly 65%of workers’ write-in task suggestions collected through the current O*NET data collection process, a major alternative source for emerging tasks. Every statement is validated by 318 incumbents in 7923 ratings of relevance and importance. Relative to the task data from the O*NET 31.0 database for the sampled occupations, TaskNet covers 75% of the 118 published O*NET tasks and adds 79 tasks with no O*NET counterpart and 58 that refine existing statements. It covers 89% of tasks reported by held-out workers, compared with 79% for O*NET, and a larger share of the activities described in employer job postings (72.5% vs. 70.2%). Downstream, TaskNet changes AI exposure estimates in both directions, raising them for Software Developers and Lawyers, two occupations where AI’s effects are widely debated. Because such estimates guide workforce policy and training, more complete and up-to-date task lists can help direct these efforts toward the workers most likely to be affected. TaskNet provides a foundation for keeping occupational information current and grounded in workers’ experiences as AI reshapes work.

35986.title: Debiasing Law Enforcement Officers: Evidence from an Expressive Arts Intervention in India
35986.zh_title: 消除执法人员的偏见：来自印度表达性艺术干预的证据
35986.authors: Sofia Amaral, Girija Borker, Nishith Prakash, María Micaela Sviatschi
35986.zh_abstract_excerpt: 一线国家代理人在公民获得公共服务方面拥有相当大的自由裁量权，但鲜有研究关注塑造这种自由裁量权的态度和信念能否在现任官僚中被改变。我们与比哈尔邦警察合作——该邦是印度最大的邦之一，在相对严峻的警务能力约束下运作——在417个警察局和约2,500名现役高级外勤警官中开展了一项整群随机对照试验，评估一项为期三天、以被压迫者剧场为基础的表达性艺术干预，旨在改变警察对性别暴力（GBV）的应对方式。
35986.abstract: Frontline state agents exercise substantial discretion over citizens’ access to public services, yet little is known about whether the attitudes and beliefs shaping this discretion can be changed among incumbent bureaucrats. Partnering with the Bihar Police - one of India’s largest states that operates under comparatively severe policing capacity constraints, we conduct a cluster randomized controlled trial across 417 police stations and roughly 2,500 active duty senior field police officers to evaluate a three-day expressive arts intervention, grounded in the Theatre of the Oppressed, designed to change police responses to gender-based violence (GBV). Approximately 7 months after baseline, treated officers exhibit more favorable attitudes toward GBV, greater empathy, and stronger legal knowledge. These changes translate into observed policing behavior: in standardized victim audits conducted one year later, officers in treated stations are 15 percentage points less likely to blame victims, dismiss fewer complaints, and provide more referrals, while administrative records show a 41 percent reduction in registration delays and, over a longer horizon, increased GBV reporting by citizens. Exploiting variation generated by officer transfers, we find suggestive evidence that these effects persist when treated officers relocate and diffuse to untreated officers working alongside treated colleagues. The effects also extend to the workplace: junior female officers working with treated senior officers report lower harassment and anxiety. These findings show that the attitudes shaping bureaucratic discretion are malleable and that changing how incumbent state agents exercise authority can improve both citizen-facing service delivery and the broader workplace environment.

35985.title: Unconventional Monetary Policy and Deposit Retention
35985.zh_title: 非常规货币政策与存款留存
35985.zh_abstract_excerpt: 非常规货币政策的两个维度——将短期利率维持在零下限（ZLB）和量化宽松（QE）——使存款构成向对利率更敏感的客户转移。ZLB通过造成利率压缩吸引了这些客户，这限制了寻找高收益流动性来源的收益。QE也吸引了对利率敏感的大额存款人，其来源是美联储从非银行机构购买债券。一旦政策正常化，流量敏感性和存款贝塔均随对QE和ZLB的暴露程度而上升。我们得出结论：非常规货币政策使银行的存款留存成本更高、风险更大。
35985.abstract: The two dimensions of unconventional monetary policy — holding the short rate at the zero-lower bound (ZLB) and quantitative easing (QE) — shifted deposit composition toward more interest-sensitive customers. The ZLB drew these customers by creating rate compression, which limited the benefit of searching for high-yielding liquidity sources. QE also drew rate-sensitive, large depositors from the Federal Reserve’s purchases of bonds from non-banks. Once policy normalized, flow sensitivity and the deposit beta both increased with exposure to QE and the ZLB. We conclude that unconventional monetary policy made deposit retention costlier and riskier for banks.

35984.title: Target What? The Foundations of Poverty Targeting
35984.zh_title: 瞄准什么？贫困瞄准的基础
35984.authors: Rema Hanna, Emily Breza, Benjamin A. Olken, Abhijit Banerjee, Arun G. Chandrasekhar, Gideon Moore
35984.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大多数政府转移支付项目旨在瞄准穷人。这样做隐含地假设最低消费家庭具有最高的边际社会估值，即从额外一美元中获得最高的社会福利增益。但情况未必如此。在600个印度尼西亚村庄中，我们请超过5,500名村民对其他村民的富裕程度以及一笔适度现金转移对他们的帮助程度进行排序，并将这些排序与消费和自评福利进行比较。以消费为瞄准标准遗漏了77%具有最高边际社会估值的家庭。以自评福利为瞄准标准遗漏了57%。
35984.abstract: Most government transfer programs aim to target the poor. Doing so implicitly assumes that the lowest-consumption households have the highest marginal social valuation, i.e., have the highest social welfare gain from an additional dollar. But this need not be the case. In 600 Indonesian villages, we ask over 5,500 villagers to rank other villagers on how well off they are and how much a modest cash transfer would help them, and compare these rankings to consumption and self-assessed welfare. Targeting consumption misses 77% of households with the highest marginal social valuation. Targeting self-assessed welfare misses 57%. Even targeting those the community ranks worst off in levels, not margins, misses 25%. Divergences between different notions of neediness are statistically predictable. In a randomized controlled trial, proxy means tests best target consumption, self-targeting ordeals capture self-assessed welfare levels, and community targeting comes closest to marginal social valuation. Targeting strategies inescapably embed normative stances.
